question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 66°, BD ⊥ AC and CE ⊥ AB. BD and EC intersect at P. The bisectors ∠PBC and ∠PCB meet at Q. What is the measure of ∠BQC?
solution:
**Given data:**

∠A = 66º

**Concept:**

The angle formed by the internal bisectors of the angles of the triangle is equal to 90 degrees plus half the third angle. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8814e97167de6b13645a8379a62f9e31f99b9114380e9ef405f890b13a02bfd6.png] 

In Δ ABC,

∠BQC = 90º + ∠BPCover 2

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55dc15659f2c798e66aa2b771bd8dffe116c12db3ac74d823a8a07d9a795f97e.png] 

In the quadrilateral AEPD

∠EAD + ∠PEA + ∠EPD + ∠PDA = 360º

⇒ ∠EPD = 360º - (66º + 90º + 90º)

⇒ ∠EPD = 114º

From figure-

∠EPD = 114º = ∠BPC

∠BQC = 90º + ∠BPCover 2

∠BQC = 90º + 114ºover 2 = 90º + 57º = 147º (since ∠EPD and ∠BPC are vertically opposite angles).

∴ , **The value of ∠BQC is 147º.**
